message.content: Halo! Saya tidak memiliki akses langsung ke inventaris produk. Bisakah Anda memberi tahu nama atau ID produk yang Anda maksud? Dengan begitu, saya bisa membantu memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS untuk Anda.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" This is Indonesian: "Hello, size XS is not available, right?" They are asking about availability of size XS. We need to respond accordingly. The user might be asking about a product. We don't have context. We can ask clarifying question or provide general answer. We can ask what product they refer to. Or we can say we don't have that info. We can ask them to specify. We can also mention that we can check inventory. But we don't have inventory data. We can ask them to provide product ID or name. So we respond politely.
